Priya Rao: quick question — for the automatic fallback policy UX, should we surface a 'decay/backoff' control to operators so rollouts don't oscillate? thinking about noisy spikes that cause flip-flop between primary and fallback. 1705050505

Mike Chen: yes — we need something. otherwise an app that spikes for 30s will get torn between variants. a cooldown window + backoff seems sensible. :thumbsup: 1705050520

Jordan Ellis: agree. two knobs: 1) immediate trigger thresholds (error_rate, latency) 2) post-trigger backoff strategy (fixed vs exponential) 3) cooldown to prevent re-triggering. also important: decision trace for audit. 1705050540

Anna Morales: UI notes: operators don't want 6 knobs. propose a compact mode with three presets (conservative, default, aggressive) + an advanced toggle that expands controls. show a small timeline sparkline next to preset so they can preview sensitivity. 1705050555

Liam O'Connor: re telemetry — we should emit a single event per decision: `fallback_decision` with fields: decision_trace_id, trigger_reason, policy_id, chosen_variant, backoff_seconds, operator_override (if any). that lets console show a breadcrumb and link to logs. sampling for full trace payloads. 1705050568

Mike Chen: API sketch (rough):

```
POST /v1/policies/:id/fallback-evaluate
{ "metrics": {"error_rate":0.06, "p95_latency_ms":1200},
  "now": 1705050568
}
```

Response includes `decision` + `decision_trace_id` and `next_allowed_trigger_ts`. backend picks backoff algorithm. 1705050580

Jordan Ellis: +1 but we should let UI show why the policy picked exponential vs fixed. minimal explainer text like: "exponential backoff used after repeated short spikes". Also store the rule version so we can replay decisions later. 1705050595

Priya Rao: about oscillation — what about a short 'grace' sampling window where we route a small pct (eg 5%) to primary while in fallback to test health? that reduces BLAM (big-loud-alarm-mode). 1705050603

Anna Morales: that's the "canary drain" pattern — nice. in the console present it as a toggle on the policy: "safepoke: hold X% traffic for primary during fallback" with tooltip. UX should emphasize operator control and easy undo (sticky override TTL). 1705050614

Liam O'Connor: storage/volume concern: decision traces blow up. propose two-tier logging: lightweight event always stored (decision id, reason, policy id, variant, backoff), full trace retained for N days or by sampling/ops-request. expose replay button in console that requests full trace on demand. 1705050627

autodeploy-bot: deploy-preview: policy-service v0.92 will include `next_allowed_trigger_ts` and `decision_trace_id` in eval response — watch for telemetry schema changes. 1705050630

Mike Chen: quick config proto we can show in advanced UI (pseudo):

```
fallback: {
  trigger: { error_rate: 0.05, p95_ms: 1000 },
  backoff: { type: "exponential", base: 2, min_sec: 60, max_sec: 3600 },
  cooldown_window_sec: 300,
  canary_pct_during_fallback: 5,
  sticky_override_ttl_sec: 900
}
```

If sticky_override_ttl_sec > 0 then operator overrides stay for that TTL unless revoked. 1705050635

Priya Rao: ok action items: Anna will mock presets + canary toggle; Mike will add API shape + telemetry fields; Jordan will write replay/audit requirements; Liam will propose storage/retention policy. We'll reconvene after sketches. thanks all. :rocket: 1705050640
